question: Who is this for in v1, and is login required? (single anonymous user / multiple users with accounts / shared lists between users)
Which todo behaviors are required for v1? (add, edit, complete/uncomplete, delete only / also due dates and priority / also tags, filters, search, and sorting)
How should tasks be organized? (one flat list / multiple named lists or projects / lists plus optional subtasks)
What visual and layout expectations do you have? (minimal/clean desktop page / mobile-first responsive / denser dashboard look; any must-have empty states, colors, or dark mode?)
What accessibility bar should we hit? (usable with keyboard only / keyboard plus screen-reader labels / explicit WCAG 2.1 AA)
What counts as done for this v1? (working persisted CRUD UI / plus validation and clear empty/error states / plus basic automated tests)
